g.text: Fingerprints add nothing to the series ID and hurt a held-out substation

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is the first arm minus the second on the quantile score over all leads; below zero favours the first arm. Grey line: no difference. C1 to C6 use the 16 Primary substations and three seeds; C7 and C8 use 8 held-out Primary substations and one seed. 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.375% interval (Bonferroni across eight contrasts).'
text.tspan: Each row is the first arm minus the second on the quantile score over all leads; below zero
favours the first arm. Grey line: no difference. C1 to C6 use the 16 Primary substations and
three seeds; C7 and C8 use 8 held-out Primary substations and one seed. 73 forecast runs,
one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather.
Dot: estimate. Line: 99.375% interval (Bonferroni across eight contrasts).
